summary: The exact candidate corrects the one remaining unsafe cookbook sentence on a base where an earlier related change had already fixed the originally enumerated pages, and its checker catches that exact one-line regression. Independent resolver runs reproduce the original uv 0.11.16 downgrade. However, the candidate is a narrow docs correction plus incomplete hardening: its line- and case-sensitive cookbook-only guard misses ordinary multiline commands, case-variant package names, and regressions in the main docs tree. It does not change uv or package metadata, so old uv still silently downgrades users who type the plain command.

tests.what_was_measured: Fresh uv 0.11.16 resolution selected sglang==0.5.9 for the historical sglang<0.5.18 release boundary.
Fresh uv 0.12.0 resolution selected sglang==0.5.17 and flash-attn-4==4.0.0b19.
The documented prerelease flag made uv 0.11.16 select sglang==0.5.17 and flash-attn-4==4.0.0b19.
Pinned sglang==0.5.10.post1 exposed flash-attn-4 prerelease rejection and uv's --prerelease=allow hint.
The candidate's regression/checker suite passed at exact commit 0f6ace775da584a0bfe330ff908470574b14fb7c.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before behavior: the checker rejected the exact one-line regression at Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.mdx:34.

tests.command: node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs (temporary multiline, SGLang case-variant, and docs/docs adversarial fixtures)
tests.what_was_measured: Adversarial failure: the checker accepted all three unsafe recommendations, demonstrating line-sensitive, case-sensitive, and scope bypasses.
Confirmed repository SGLang source import, prepared Torch/ROCm import, HIP 7.2.26015, and one visible GPU.

gpu_execution.evidence: Resolution and documentation behavior are CPU/network deterministic. One gfx950 GPU was visible, but no GPU run can qualify the reported Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 TP=2 consequence without its weights and two-GPU topology.

remaining_counterexamples: A cookbook recommendation split as `uv pip install \` followed by `sglang` on the next line passes the candidate checker while uv 0.11.16 remains vulnerable.
`uv pip install SGLang` passes the candidate checker even though Python package names are case-insensitive.
An unsafe command added under docs/docs (including install or quickstart pages) is outside the candidate checker's scope.
A user manually running the obvious plain `uv pip install sglang` command with uv 0.11.16 still silently resolves the historical release set to 0.5.9; the candidate mitigates documentation only.
remaining_limitations: The original Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 semantic error was not reproduced: the assigned host exposes one gfx950 GPU, while the report requires TP=2 and unavailable model weights.
No tiny-model or startup smoke was substituted for the unavailable architecture/topology claim.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native or Python runtime source.
Network resolution was evaluated against the package index as available on 2026-09-12, constrained to sglang<0.5.18 to reproduce the issue's historical release boundary.
